subtitle: An exposed Atlantic beach on the edge of the Sintra-Cascais Natural Park, 5 km from Cascais, where the summer nortada wind made Portugal's home of wave-sailing.
spike_statement: The Serra de Sintra funnels a hard summer north wind, the nortada, onto Guincho, making this Atlantic beach Portugal's home of wave-sailing.

levers.photo_tone: Nortada spray blown off the whitecaps, pale mobile dune sand streaming inland, the Serra de Sintra dark behind an exposed Atlantic beach
